question: As announced on 21 June 2025, Central Health Ministry is looking at integrating India’s Rare Donor Registry with the national online platform for blood bank management and blood availability information, called ____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**e-Rakt Kosh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Central Health Ministry** of India announced on **21 June 2025** the integration of the **Rare Donor Registry** with the existing national online platform for blood management.
 
• The platform, known as **e-Rakt Kosh**, serves as a centralized **Blood Bank Management System** that provides real-time data on blood availability across various hospitals and blood banks in the country. ***Hence, the correct answer is e-Rakt Kosh.***
 
• The primary objective of this integration is to ensure that patients requiring rare blood groups, such as the **Bombay blood group** or the **Rh-null phenotype**, can be matched with donors quickly through a unified digital interface.
 
• **e-Rakt Kosh** acts as a comprehensive portal that tracks the entire lifecycle of blood units, from **donation** to **testing**, **storage**, and final **transfusion** to the patient.
